Frequently Asked Questions

1. Why is the price of the package so low?

We are providing a digital study materials in PDF format. We've teamed up with students to create a complete set of resources. Since we're selling the package to many students, we can offer it at a low price.

2. How will I receive my package?

Once your payment is complete, You will be automatically redirected to the download section of the page. Click the download button & file will be downloaded on your device. We will request you to wait for the redirection of download page after you're done with your payment.

3. What if I don't receive my package after purchase?

We have never faced this issue till now, just send us an email with your order details and we will send you a new one. Kindly provide your correct name, email, phone number details while Buying, so that you can get the product link to your correct email id which you give in cart checkout page.

4. What if I lose my package?

We would advise you to download the product after making the purchase. If you encounter any issues after the purchase, please feel free to email us.

5. How long can I access the material?

You will have lifetime access to the package but we suggest to download it.

7. Which Payment Mode is accepted?

We accept UPI, Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, Credit Card, Debit Card and Net banking, with secure payment gateway.
